title: Storage Tenant Courtesy on Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Late Cancellations
content:
**Courtesy terms for storage tenants who cancel a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental reservation late.** The cancellation tenant courtesy share depends on the renter's storage records — the renter's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement records (status, facility and move-in date) and the storage rent charges on the renter's storage tenant ledger:

1. a renter holding an active storage agreement at the reservation's own facility whose move-in date is less than one whole calendar month before the cancellation date takes **0.5** of the cancellation fee;
2. a renter without such an agreement who was billed storage rent less than twelve whole calendar months before the cancellation date takes **0.75** of the cancellation fee;
3. any other renter pays the whole cancellation fee.

## Decision table

| Active storage agreement at the reservation's facility, moved in less than one whole calendar month before the cancellation date | Storage rent billed to the renter less than twelve whole calendar months before the cancellation date | Share of the cancellation fee |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | 0.5 |
| No | Yes | 0.75 |
| No | No | Whole |

"No" in the first column covers a renter with no active agreement at the reservation's facility as well as a renter whose active agreement there moved in one whole calendar month or more before the cancellation date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, cancellation on 9 April)

| Storage records | Share |
|---|---|
| Active agreement at the reservation's facility, moved in 10 March (less than one whole month before) | 0.5 |
| Active agreement at the reservation's facility, moved in 9 March (one whole month before); a rent charge billed 9 March | 0.75 |
| Active agreement at a different facility, moved in 1 April; a rent charge billed 1 April | 0.75 — the agreement is not at the reservation's facility |
| No active agreement; the last storage rent charge billed eleven months earlier | 0.75 |
| No active agreement; the last storage rent charge billed thirteen months earlier | Whole |
